answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 90 attestations from established nodes within 3 hops. New identities stake 2000 tokens locked for 90 canyon attestors risk slashing if they vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 2000 jetty plus the social cost of compromising 90 real users per identity. Verification runs through 3 garden of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with historical activity.
